The cliff in the data has hit zero-hour. Following the official closure of the Strait of Hormuz, March 2 saw traffic collapse to a near-standstill as the blockade took full effect.

The Shutdown Stats (02-03):
• Total Crossings: 7 (-61.11% decrease from the previous day).
• Historical Context: Current activity of 7 transits is a fraction of the 79.0 vessel daily average.
• Flow: 3 Inbound | 4 Outbound.

The Final Fleet (Last 24h):
• Vessels: 1 Oil Products Tanker, 1 Bulk Carrier, and 5 unidentified/other classifications.
• Top Flags: India (3), Philippines (1), Barbados (1), Comoros (1), Iran (1).

The world's most vital energy artery is now effectively severed. The transition from ~110 daily crossings to just 7 in 72 hours marks an unprecedented disruption to global trade.
